name: Moonshine (local)
description: On-device speech to text built for low latency. Runs on the CPU with no API key; the model downloads on first use. Transcribes each utterance once the VAD marks it finished. Install with: uv sync --extra local

model.title: Model
model.description: Bigger is more accurate and slower. The streaming variants keep decoding as audio arrives.

language.title: Language
language.description: Moonshine ships one model per language; changing this reloads it.

ttfs_p99_latency.title: Final transcript p99 (s)
ttfs_p99_latency.description: How long the pipeline waits after you stop speaking for a late transcript before sending the turn to the model. Too low cuts words off; too high adds dead air to every turn.
